system.flavor: A battle rifle along the lines of the FN-FAL, firing similar caseless cartridges but not as reliable. Identifiable by the gold flower on the stock. The standard rifle of the PLA.
system.notes:
Pacific Rim p.77 (PDF idx 77). The shipped OCR layer drops this stat row entirely; a fresh tesseract pass over the page image at two zoom/psm settings resolves it consistently: RIF 0 N P 6d6+2 (7.62) 35 25 ST 400m. Price printed as 500 YY (125 Eb).

Blackhand's Street Weapons p.27 (PDF idx 28) reprints it, citing [Pacific Rim], under the designation 'CCMMC Jinhua M-9': 500 YY (125eb), RIF 0 N P 6D6+2 (7.62MM) 35 1/25 ST 400M. Pacific Rim's own 'M-7' designation is kept.
